docs.cv:
Tomislav Mesarić
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia | +385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Butcher and meat-counter professional with experience since 2015 in carcass breakdown, portioning, fresh sausage production and customer service. Skilled in beef, pork and lamb preparation, FIFO stock rotation, cold-chain temperature checks and hygienic equipment cleaning. Holds a vocational butcher certificate and a current basic HACCP food hygiene certificate.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Butcher, Mesnica Kod Ante (family butcher shop), Zagreb | 2019–Present
- Break down 2–3 beef forequarters and 10–12 pork sides per week; bone, trim and portion meat for the counter.
- Produce four fresh sausage varieties using the shop’s recipes; make about 40 kg per week in the busy season.
- Developed the shop’s lamb merguez recipe and adjusted the ćevapi mix to 70% beef and 30% lamb following customer feedback; the ćevapi won second place at the 2023 Zagreb County craft meat fair.
- Record cold-room and display-counter temperature checks twice daily, maintaining cold-room temperatures at 0–4 °C.
- Rotate cold-room stock every morning using FIFO, placing the oldest products at the front.
- Serve about 120 customers on Saturdays and advise on cuts and cooking times.
- Trained two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines.
- Prepare whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting at weddings and family parties; ordered, butchered, seasoned and delivered the meat. Largest order: four lambs and two pigs for a 180-guest wedding in 2024.
- Ran a six-week dry-ageing trial of beef ribs, recording weight loss and temperature; the shop now sells dry-aged rib by pre-order.

Counter Assistant, Tržnica Dolac meat hall stall, Zagreb | 2015–2019
- Served customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and completed cash-up.
- Cleaned and sanitised slicers, mincers and the counter at close.
- Wrote a one-page closing and cleaning checklist following a hygiene inspection remark; it remains in use at the stall.

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATES
Vocational certificate: Butcher, Food Trades School Zagreb, 2015 (3-year programme)
HACCP basic food hygiene certificate, 2021; renewed 2024
Preparing for the master butcher exam (majstorski ispit), planned for spring 2027

SKILLS
Carcass breakdown (beef, pork and lamb); boning and trimming; meat portioning; fresh sausage making; knife sharpening; mincer and bandsaw operation; FIFO stock rotation; cold-chain temperature checks; HACCP hygiene records; equipment cleaning and sanitising; customer advice; cash handling

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native); English (good); German (basic)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant position at FreshCart’s Zagreb-Jarun store. I bring hands-on butcher and meat-counter experience dating back to 2015, with practical skills in cutting, portioning, customer advice and food hygiene.

At Mesnica Kod Ante, I break down beef and pork, prepare fresh sausage, and advise customers on cuts and cooking times. I record temperature checks twice daily and rotate cold-room stock every morning using FIFO. I also serve around 120 customers on a typical Saturday and have trained two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines.

Alongside daily counter work, I have prepared whole lambs and suckling pigs for events and developed products for the shop’s sausage range. The ćevapi recipe I adjusted with customer feedback won second place at the 2023 Zagreb County craft meat fair. My basic HACCP food hygiene certificate was renewed in 2024. FreshCart’s emphasis on fresh local food and knowledgeable counter service is a strong match for my experience advising customers and preparing meat.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience could contribute to the FreshCart meat counter team.

Kind regards,
Tomislav Mesarić
